statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and presyncope
The patient has been diagnosed with unspecified atrial fibrillation (R55, I48.91)
Standard short-term monitoring has failed to capture the arrhythmic events correlating with these symptoms
The service was to evaluate for intermittent high-grade conduction disease or paroxysmal arrhythmias
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered
